standard_prerequisites.name: The Baer criterion for injectivity through extensions from ideals
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 515-517) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces injectivity to extending maps from ideals.

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that ideals of a Noetherian ring are finitely generated
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 518-520)
standard_prerequisites.use: Confines the image of the map to finitely many summands.

core_obligations: Apply the Baer criterion: a map from an ideal into the direct sum is at issue (proof lines 514-517)
Finiteness: by Noetherianity the ideal is finitely generated, so the image lies in a finite subsum (proof lines 518-521)
Conclusion: the map extends into that finite subsum by injectivity of its members, hence into the whole sum (proof lines 522-523)
proof_roadmap: 由 Baer 判据，只需把理想 J 的映射 φ 延拓出去。
R Noetherian ⇒ J 有限生成 ⇒ 存在有限个指标 i_1,…,i_r 使 φ 的像落在 ⊕E_{i_j} 中。
由各 E_{i_j} 内射，φ 可延拓到该有限直和（再嵌入 E）⇒ E 内射。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that over a Noetherian ring a direct sum of injective modules is injective (author lemma at source lines 508-512, label lemma-sum-injective-modules). The proof (source lines 514-524) invokes the Baer criterion, uses finite generation of ideals to confine the image to finitely many summands and extends there (proof lines 514-523). The finiteness reduction is the substance. H3.
